'use strict';async (__vite_ssr_exports__,__vite_ssr_import_meta__,__vite_ssr_import__,__vite_ssr_dynamic_import__,__vite_ssr_exportAll__,__vite_ssr_exportName__,__filename,__dirname,module,exports,require)=>{{__vite_ssr_exportName__("checkWithCleanup", () => { try { return checkWithCleanup } catch {} });
__vite_ssr_exportName__("virtualFieldNames", () => { try { return virtualFieldNames } catch {} });
__vite_ssr_exportName__("captureMetadataRows", () => { try { return captureMetadataRows } catch {} });
async function checkWithCleanup(check, cleanups) {
  let primaryFailure;
  let checkFailed = false;
  try {
    await check();
  } catch (error) {
    primaryFailure = error;
    checkFailed = true;
  };
  const cleanupFailures = [];
  for (const cleanup of cleanups) {
    try {
      await cleanup();
    } catch (error) {
      cleanupFailures.push(error);
    }
  };
  if (cleanupFailures.length > 0) {
    throw new AggregateError(
      cleanupFailures,
      `Virtual row oracle check and cleanup failed`,
      {
        cause: primaryFailure
      }
    );
  };
  if (checkFailed) throw primaryFailure;
};
const virtualFieldNames = [
  `$key`,
  `$hasPendingWrites`,
  `$origin`,
  `$collectionId`
];
function captureMetadataRows(rows) {
  return rows.map((row) => ({
    ...row,
    ...Object.fromEntries(
      virtualFieldNames.map((field) => [
        field,
        row[field]
      ])
    )
  }));
}
